title: trigger.get
description: Retrieve triggers according to the given parameters.

triggerids.description: Return only triggers with the given IDs.

groupids.description: Return only triggers that belong to hosts or templates from the given host groups or template groups.

templateids.description: Return only triggers that belong to the given templates.

hostids.description: Return only triggers that belong to the given hosts.

itemids.description: Return only triggers that contain the given items.

functions.description:
Return only triggers that use the given functions.

Refer to the supported function page (/manual/appendix/functions) for a list of supported functions.

group.description: Return only triggers that belong to hosts or templates from the host group or template group with the given name.

host.description: Return only triggers that belong to host with the given technical name.

inherited.description: If set to true return only triggers inherited from a template.

templated.description: If set to true return only triggers that belong to templates.

dependent.description: If set to true return only triggers that have dependencies. If set to false return only triggers that do not have dependencies.

monitored.description: Return only enabled triggers that belong to monitored hosts and contain only enabled items.

active.description: Return only enabled triggers that belong to monitored hosts.

maintenance.description: If set to true return only enabled triggers that belong to hosts in maintenance.

withUnacknowledgedEvents.description: Return only triggers that have unacknowledged events.

withAcknowledgedEvents.description: Return only triggers with all events acknowledged.

withLastEventUnacknowledged.description: Return only triggers with the last event unacknowledged.

skipDependent.description: Skip triggers in a problem state that are dependent on other triggers. Note that the other triggers are ignored if disabled, have disabled items or disabled item hosts.

lastChangeSince.description: Return only triggers that have changed their state after the given time.

lastChangeTill.description: Return only triggers that have changed their state before the given time.

only_true.description: Return only triggers that have been in a problem state recently (within the ok_period, see /manual/api/reference/settings/object).

min_severity.description: Return only triggers with severity greater or equal than the given severity.

evaltype.description:
Tag evaluation method.

Possible values:
0 - (default) And/Or;
2 - Or.

expandComment.description: Expand macros in the trigger description.

expandDescription.description: Expand macros in the name of the trigger.

expandExpression.description: Expand functions and macros in the trigger expression.

selectHostGroups.description: Return the host groups that the trigger belongs to in the hostgroups property.

selectHosts.description: Return the hosts that the trigger belongs to in the hosts property.

selectItems.description: Return items contained by the trigger in the items property.

selectDependencies.description: Return triggers that the trigger depends on in the dependencies property.

selectDiscoveryRule.description: Return the low-level discovery rule that created the trigger in the discoveryRule property.

selectLastEvent.description: Return the last significant trigger event in the lastEvent property.

selectTags.description: Return the trigger tags in tags property.

selectTemplateGroups.description: Return the template groups that the trigger belongs to in the templategroups property.

selectGroups.description:
Deprecated. Please use selectHostGroups or selectTemplateGroups instead.
Return the host groups and template groups that the trigger belongs to in the groups property.

filter.description:
Return only those results that exactly match the given filter.

Accepts an object, where the keys are property names, and the values are either a single value or an array of values to match against.

Does not support properties of text data type.

Supports additional properties:
host - technical name of the host that the trigger belongs to;
hostid - ID of the host that the trigger belongs to.

limitSelects.description:
Limits the number of records returned by subselects.

Applies to the following subselects:
selectHosts - results will be sorted by host.

sortfield.description:
Sort the result by the given properties.

Possible values: triggerid, description, status, priority, lastchange, hostname.

countOutput.description: Return the number of records in the result instead of the actual data.

editable.description: If set to true, return only objects that the user has write permissions to. Default: false.

excludeSearch.description: Return results that do not match the criteria given in the search parameter.

limit.description: Limit the number of records returned.

output.description: Object properties to be returned. Default: extend.

preservekeys.description: Use IDs as keys in the resulting array.

search.description: Return results that match the given pattern (case-insensitive). Supports string and text properties.

searchByAny.description: If true, return results that match any of the criteria given in the filter or search parameter. Default: false.

searchWildcardsEnabled.description: If true, enables the use of '*' as a wildcard character. Default: false.

sortorder.description: Order of sorting. ASC or DESC.

startSearch.description: The search parameter will compare the beginning of fields. Ignored if searchWildcardsEnabled is set.
